'''White Tail''' is a [[wolf]] belonging to [[Leafhunter|Leafhunter's]] pack.{{ref|{{twotc}}, White Tail}} 

==Activities==
White Tail, along with the rest of the pack, are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. When Perrin asks the wolves to identify a scent, all but Leafhunter break contact as they recognize the scent: the scent of [[Darkhound]]s.{{ref/book|10|5}}
